question: In January 2025, who was honoured with the Maharaja Hari Singh Award for administrative reforms in Jammu and Kashmir?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Manoj Sinha**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Manoj Sinha, the Lieutenant Governor of Jammu and Kashmir, was honoured with the **Maharaja Hari Singh Award** for administrative reforms in January 2025.
 
• The award recognized his efforts in implementing **progressive administrative policies** that have contributed to the development and governance of the region.
 
• Under his leadership, Jammu and Kashmir has seen significant advancements in infrastructure, public service delivery, and transparency in administration.
 
• His initiatives have been focused on strengthening **grassroots democracy** and ensuring inclusive development across the Union Territory.
 
• The Maharaja Hari Singh Award is named after the last ruling monarch of Jammu and Kashmir, known for his contributions to social and administrative reforms.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Maharaja Hari Singh's Legacy**

 
 
• Maharaja Hari Singh was the last Dogra ruler of Jammu and Kashmir, serving from 1925 to 1947.
 
• He was known for his progressive reforms, including the abolition of untouchability and promotion of education.
 
• He played a key role in integrating Jammu and Kashmir into the Indian Union post-independence.
 
 
 
• **Administrative Reforms in Jammu and Kashmir**
 
 
• Post the abrogation of Article 370 in 2019, the region has undergone significant administrative restructuring.
 
• Key reforms include the implementation of central laws, establishment of Panchayati Raj institutions, and enhanced focus on development projects.
 
• Efforts have been made to improve transparency, governance, and delivery of public services.
 
 
 
• **Grassroots Democracy in J&K**
 
 
• Grassroots democracy has been strengthened through regular elections for Panchayats and Urban Local Bodies.
 
• Increased participation of citizens in decision-making processes has been a major focus area.
 
• These measures aim to empower the local population and ensure equitable development.
 
 
 
• **Developmental Initiatives**
 
 
• Major infrastructure projects like road connectivity, power generation, and health facilities have been prioritized.
 
• Investment in education and skill development programs has been a cornerstone of the region's development strategy.
 
• Tourism promotion and industrial development have been key drivers of economic growth in Jammu and Kashmir.
